stories.title: Cousins emotional after win in Vikings return, reflects on 'tough three years'
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins was emotional discussing his return to the Vikings after their victory over the Packers.

stories.title: 'Punched in the face,' Raiders' Mendoza vows to learn from first NFL start
stories.summary: Fernando Mendoza completed 17 of 29 passes for 143 yards and had a passer rating of 71.5 in his first regular-season start for the Raiders.

stories.title: 49ers tout 'incredibly dangerous' offense after 584-yard showing vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: The 49ers racked up 584 yards against the Cowboys on Sunday in a jaw-dropping offensive display led by Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and Deebo Samuel.

stories.title: Oklahoma, boosted by crowd's ire at postponement, beats Ole Miss
stories.summary: The Oklahoma crowd let Ole Miss know what they thought of having their game delayed by a day, and the Sooners rode that energy to a 24-17 win over the Rebels.

stories.title: Toronto Tempo win 2027 WNBA draft lottery, land No. 1 pick
stories.summary: The Tempo won the WNBA draft lottery Sunday night, earning the No. 1 pick and potentially the chance to draft USC star JuJu Watkins. The Comets will choose second, followed by the Mystics.
